topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: It’s strange, isn’t it, how time can turn the pages on our lives, sometimes without us even noticing? I recently bumped into someone from my past, someone who was once more than just a friend—someone who was like a piece of me. We used to run the same streets, share the same secrets, and dream the same dreams. Yet, when we met, there was a pause, a flicker of confusion in their eyes. They didn’t remember me. It’s a curious feeling, standing there, a part of my history unacknowledged. But I realized, not everyone can keep every memory, and maybe the memories we keep inside us are enough to carry us forward. So, I smiled, introduced myself again, and perhaps, in that moment, a new story began.
